title.narrative: PROCOFSERVICES and P0301 for Central Asia Regional HIV/AIDS Project (CARHAP)

description.narrative: This activity PROCOFSERVICES and P0301 for Central Asia Regional HIV/AIDS Project (CARHAP) is a component of Central Asia Regional HIV/AIDS Project (CARHAP) reported by FCDO with a funding type of 104 - Procurement of Services and a budget of £8,666,093. This project benefits Asia, regional. It works in the following sector(s): STD control including HIV/AIDS.
